summary: Added standalone ferby-local-cache crate with injected root and bounded private PNG storage. API covers open/store/list/read/remove/prune and 30-day expiry; validates safe IDs, PNG signatures, count/entry/disk limits, metadata consistency and symlink rejection. Uses atomic writes and 0700/0600 Unix permissions; never touches originals. Root wiring remains Codex-owned.
